184	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) }
185	
186	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` for slot `i` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library
187	contract; §37, §89). -/
188	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
189	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
190	
191	/-- `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §58; non-normative library
192	contract): `reject` without the pool or a static precondition; then `fail` when no slot is free;
193	`ok` on any free slot. -/
194	inductive AllocSlotStep (j dst : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
195	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
196	  | static {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
197	      AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
198	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
199	      (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.live = true) → AllocSlotStep j dst L .fail
200	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
201	      pl.slots[i]? = some sl → sl.live = false →
202	      AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok (allocSlotEff L j pl i sl dst))
203	
204	/-! ## `resolve`, `resolveMany` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5, HP5-6) -/
205	
206	/-- Validity of a handle for pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, D.3, HP5-5, HP5-6; §89;
207	non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active, §46 analogue: a handle of a
208	dead pool is stale, HP5-5), the handle names the pool, and it designates a live slot at its
209	generation (a handle of a free entry is stale, HP5-6); a slot index outside the pool designates
210	nothing. -/
211	def HandleOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
212	  s.Active pl.internal ∧ h.id = pl.id ∧
213	    OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
214	
215	/-- Decidability of `HandleOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §89). -/
216	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK s pl h) := by
217	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
218	
219	/-- Legal exercise of `internal` at mode `m` for the companion (HandlePool v0.5, D.2;
220	non-normative library contract): the preconditions of the `derive` of the companion from
221	`internal` over all leaves of the storage (§60). -/
222	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
223	  DerivePre s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
224	
225	/-- Decidability of `ResolveRight` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60). -/
226	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
227	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
228	
229	/-- State after the companion (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60 effect; non-normative library contract):
230	authority `|A|`, derived from `internal` at mode `m` over all leaves of the storage. -/
231	def compS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
232	  deriveEff s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
233	
234	/-- Observe derivations from `c`, one per region in order (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: `resolveMany` in
235	`Observe`; §60; non-normative library contract): each accepted in the state left by the previous
236	ones. -/
237	def DerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Prop
238	  | [] => True
239	  | r :: rs => DerivePre s c r .observe ∧ DerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
240	
241	/-- Decidability of `DerivesPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, §60). -/
242	instance decDerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) :
243	    (rs : List (List Nat)) → Decidable (DerivesPre s c rs)
244	  | [] => isTrue trivial
245	  | r :: rs =>
246	    have := decDerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
247	    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
248	
249	/-- Effect of the `Observe` derivations from `c`, in order (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60 effect). -/
250	def derivesEff (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → S3
251	  | [] => s
252	  | r :: rs => derivesEff (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
253	
254	/-- Entry authorities of a batch from the companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative
255	library contract): `split` (§61) in `Modify`, successive `Observe` derivations (§60) in
256	`Observe`. -/
257	def EntriesPre (k : K) : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → Prop
258	  | .modify, s, c, rs => SplitPre k s c rs
259	  | .observe, s, c, rs => DerivesPre s c rs
260	
261	/-- Decidability of `EntriesPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60, §61). -/
262	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (m : Mode) (s : S3) (c : Nat)
263	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (EntriesPre k m s c rs) := by
264	  cases m <;> unfold EntriesPre <;> infer_instance
265	
266	/-- Effect of the entry authorities of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60, §61 effects). -/
267	def entriesEff : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → S3
268	  | .modify, s, c, rs => splitEff s c rs
269	  | .observe, s, c, rs => derivesEff s c rs
270	
271	/-- Regions of the entries designated by a batch: the footprint of each slot (HandlePool v0.5,
272	D.2; non-normative library contract; §60). -/
273	def entryRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
274	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
275	
276	/-- Ghost entries of a batch: the `n`-th entry authority is `c + 1 + n`, for slot and generation of
277	the `n`-th handle (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary, §38). -/
278	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
279	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
280	
281	/-- `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5, HP5-6; §58, §89;
282	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead
283	pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject`
284	without the legal exercise of `internal`; then the companion and the entry authority derived from
285	it, `reject` when the second derivation is not accepted. -/
286	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
287	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
288	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h →
289	      ResolveStep j h m L .fail
290	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
291	      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
292	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
293	      ResolveRight L.kern pl m → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
294	      ¬ DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
295	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
296	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
297	      ResolveRight L.kern pl m → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
298	      DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
299	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
300	        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
301	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
302	          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
303	
304	/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; non-normative library contract): every
305	handle is valid (`HandleOK`); pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
306	def BatchOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
307	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK s pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)
308	
309	/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58, §89). -/
310	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK s pl hs m) := by
311	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
312	
313	/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; §58;
314	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then an atomic `fail` for an invalid
315	batch, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject` without the legal exercise of
316	`internal`; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject` when they are
317	not accepted. -/
318	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
319	    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
320	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
321	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
322	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
323	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
324	      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
325	  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
326	      ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
327	      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
328	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
329	  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
330	      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
331	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
332	        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
333	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
334	          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })
335	
336	/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2) -/
337	
338	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
339	accepted (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
340	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
341	  | s, [] => some s
342	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
343	
344	/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
345	def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
346	
347	/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative library
348	contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
349	def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
350	  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]
351	
352	/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58; non-normative library contract): the
353	releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no companion. -/
354	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
355	  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
356	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
357	      UnresolveStep c L .reject
358	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
359	      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
360	      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })
361	
362	/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 as amended by HP5-1) -/
363	
364	/-- No active strict descendant of a companion recorded for pool `pl` covers a leaf of place `q`
365	(HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, and D.4 (3) restricted to the companions of the slot's pool, HP5-4; §42:
366	descendants along the origin chain; non-normative library contract). The companions of `pl` are
367	those of the resolutions recorded for its identity. -/
368	def NoCompDesc (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
369	  ∀ r ∈ L.res, r.pool = pl.id → ∀ x ∈ List.range L.kern.A.length, L.kern.Active x →
370	    r.comp ∈ L.kern.ancs x → ∀ l ∈ L.kern.afp x, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P q
371	
372	/-- Decidability of `NoCompDesc` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; §42). -/
373	instance (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (NoCompDesc L pl q) := by
374	  unfold NoCompDesc; infer_instance
375	
376	/-- Content conditions of `freeSlot` on slot place `q` of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1;
377	non-normative library contract; §41, §42). -/
378	structure FreeContentOK (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop where
379	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry is `Init`; each is `Uninit` or `Moved`
380	  (§41). -/
381	  notInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init
382	  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no active authority derived from a companion of this pool (a strict
383	  descendant of a companion recorded for this pool) covers a leaf of the entry. -/
384	  noCompDesc : NoCompDesc L pl q
385	
386	/-- Decidability of `FreeContentOK` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; §41, §42). -/
387	instance (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (FreeContentOK L pl q) :=
388	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoCompDesc L pl q)
389	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
390	
391	/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; non-normative library
392	contract): the slot becomes free and its generation is incremented; there is no end-of-use effect
393	and the kernel state is unchanged (§36: the library adds no rights to the kernel). -/
394	def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
395	  { L with pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }
396	
397	/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1; §58;
398	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool or without the administration right
399	(live pool and `MetaRight`); then `fail` for a handle of another pool, stale, absent or free; then
400	`reject` unless the content conditions hold (`FreeContentOK`). This is the outcome order of
401	HandlePool v0.4, kept by HP5-1: the order of HP5-5 (handle before right) concerns resolution
402	(§89) only. -/
403	inductive FreeSlotStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
404	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
405	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
406	      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
407	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h →
408	      FreeSlotStep j h L .fail
409	  | noContent {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl →
410	      HandleOK L.kern pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
411	      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
412	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl →
413	      HandleOK L.kern pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
414	      FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))
415	
416	/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.5; §38, §46, §47) -/
417	
418	/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract): a kernel
419	step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool operation
420	(§58). -/
421	inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
422	  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
423	  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
424	      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
425	  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
426	  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
427	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
428	  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
429	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
430	  | unresolve {L L' : PState} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
431	  | freeSlot {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L') →
432	      PStep k L L'
433	
434	/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps
435	(HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract). -/
436	inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
437	  | init : PReach k statics (PState.init statics)
438	  | step {L L' : PState} : PReach k statics L → PStep k L L' → PReach k statics L'
439	
440	/-! ## Kernel side of the pool operations (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7) -/
441	
442	/-- Finite sequences of kernel steps O1–O16 (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
443	inductive KSeq (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
444	  | refl (s : S3) : KSeq k s s
445	  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : KSeq k s s₁ → KStep k s₁ s₂ → KSeq k s s₂
446	
447	/-- Sequences of kernel steps compose (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
448	theorem KSeq.trans {k : K} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} (h₁ : KSeq k s₁ s₂) (h₂ : KSeq k s₂ s₃) :
449	    KSeq k s₁ s₃ := by
450	  induction h₂ with
451	  | refl => exact h₁
452	  | tail _ hs ih => exact .tail ih hs
453	
454	/-- One kernel step is a sequence (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
455	theorem KSeq.single {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : KSeq k s s' := .tail (.refl s) h
456	
457	/-- Kernel reachability (§57) is closed under sequences of kernel steps (HandlePool v0.5,
458	HP5-7). -/
459	theorem KSeq.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
460	    (h : KSeq k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
461	  induction h with
462	  | refl => exact hr
463	  | tail _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs
464	
465	/-- `releaseAll` is a sequence of `release` steps (§62; HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
466	theorem releaseAll_kseq {k : K} : ∀ {s s' : S3} {l : List Nat}, releaseAll s l = some s' →
467	    KSeq k s s'
468	  | s, s', [], h => by simp only [releaseAll, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact .refl s
469	  | s, s', a :: l, h => by
470	    simp only [releaseAll] at h
471	    split at h
472	    · rename_i hpre
473	      exact (KSeq.single (.release (Guarded.ok hpre))).trans (releaseAll_kseq h)
474	    · cases h
475	
476	/-- The `Observe` derivations of `resolveMany` are a sequence of `derive` steps (§60;
477	HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
478	theorem derives_kseq {k : K} {c : Nat} : ∀ {s : S3} {rs : List (List Nat)}, DerivesPre s c rs →
479	    KSeq k s (derivesEff s c rs)
480	  | s, [], _ => .refl s
481	  | _, _ :: _, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok h₁))).trans (derives_kseq h₂)
482	
483	/-- The entry authorities of `resolveMany` are a `split` (§61) or a sequence of `derive` steps
484	(§60) (HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
485	theorem entries_kseq {k : K} {m : Mode} {s : S3} {c : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
486	    (h : EntriesPre k m s c rs) : KSeq k s (entriesEff m s c rs) := by
487	  cases m with
488	  | modify => exact KSeq.single (.split (Guarded.ok h))
489	  | observe => exact derives_kseq h
490	
491	/-- Under `KInv` (§57), an authority `a` exercisable in `Modify` with effective `Modify` over every
492	leaf of a usable place `q` satisfies the preconditions of an ordinary write (§67) of any leaves of
493	`q` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3: the write of the handle; HP5-3: the write of the pool value). -/
494	theorem write_of_right {s : S3} (hk : KInv s) {q a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hu : s.Usable q)
495	    (hex : s.ExercisableAt a .modify)
496	    (hall : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) .modify)
497	    (hls : ∀ l ∈ ls, l ∈ footprint s.P q) : Write3Pre s a ls := by
498	  refine ⟨fun l hl => ⟨q, List.mem_range.2 hu.lt, hu, hls l hl⟩, hex,
499	    fun l hl => Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l (hls l hl)),
500	    fun l hl b _ hb => effective_exclusive hk.2.1.1.1 (Ne.symm hb)
501	      (Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l (hls l hl))), fun l hl => ?_⟩
502	  obtain ⟨-, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hls l hl)
503	  have hul : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hk.1 (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hu
504	  exact fun q' _ hq' x hx => hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 q' (usable_of_part hk.1 hq' hul) x hx
505	
506	/-- What a pool step is on the kernel side (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7; §57, §58): under `KInv`, every
507	library step is a finite sequence of accepted kernel steps O1–O16: `newPool` and `freeSlot` none
508	(the identity, HP5-1), `allocSlot` one `write` (§67), `resolve` two `derive` (§60), `resolveMany`
509	one `derive` then one `split` (§61) or one `derive` per handle, `unresolve` `release` steps
510	(§62). -/
511	theorem pstep_kernel {k : K} {L L' : PState} (hk : KInv L.kern) (h : PStep k L L') :
512	    KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
513	  cases h with
514	  | kernel hs => exact KSeq.single hs
515	  | newPool hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .refl _
516	  | allocSlot hs =>
517	    cases hs with
518	    | ok _ hst _ _ =>
519	      obtain ⟨a, -, hex, hall⟩ := hst.dstRight
520	      exact KSeq.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok (write_of_right hk hst.dstUsable hex hall
521	        fun l hl => by
522	          rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]
523	          exact mem_footprint.2 ⟨hst.dstUsable.lt, hst.dstLeaf, hst.dstUsable.lt, .inl rfl⟩)))
524	  | resolve hs =>
525	    cases hs with
526	    | ok _ _ hR _ hE =>
527	      exact (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).tail (.derive (Guarded.ok hE))
528	  | resolveMany hs =>
529	    cases hs with
530	    | ok _ _ hR hE => exact (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).trans (entries_kseq hE)
531	  | unresolve hs =>
532	    cases hs with
533	    | ok _ hr => exact releaseAll_kseq hr
534	  | freeSlot hs =>
535	    cases hs with
536	    | ok => exact .refl _

608	/-- Two parts containing a common leaf are related by the parent chain (§40; HandlePool v0.5). -/
609	theorem chain_total {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ a b, a ∈ i :: chain org i →
610	    b ∈ i :: chain org i → a = b ∨ a ∈ chain org b ∨ b ∈ chain org a
611	  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
612	  | n + 1, i, hi, a, b, ha, hb => by
613	    cases ho : org i with
614	    | none =>
615	      rw [chain_none ho] at ha hb
616	      rw [List.mem_singleton.1 ha, List.mem_singleton.1 hb]; exact .inl rfl
617	    | some o =>
618	      by_cases hlt : o < i
619	      · have hc := chain_cons ho hlt
620	        rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb
621	        · exact .inl rfl
622	        · exact .inr (.inr hb)
623	        · exact .inr (.inl ha)
624	        · rw [hc] at ha hb; exact chain_total n o (by omega) a b ha hb
625	      · have hc : chain org i = [] := by
626	          cases i with
627	          | zero => rfl
628	          | succ k => simp [chain, chainF, ho, hlt]
629	        rw [hc] at ha hb
630	        rw [List.mem_singleton.1 ha, List.mem_singleton.1 hb]; exact .inl rfl

632	/-- Two distinct children of a place have disjoint footprints under `WF3` (§40, §49.2;
633	HandlePool v0.5, D.1: slots are pairwise disjoint). -/
634	theorem kids_disjoint {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {st q₁ q₂ : Nat} (h₁ : q₁ ∈ kids s.P st)
635	    (h₂ : q₂ ∈ kids s.P st) (hne : q₁ ≠ q₂) : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q₁, l ∉ footprint s.P q₂ := by
636	  intro l hl₁ hl₂
637	  obtain ⟨-, hp₁⟩ := mem_kids.1 h₁
638	  obtain ⟨-, hp₂⟩ := mem_kids.1 h₂
639	  have hpar : ∀ i o, parentOf s.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1
640	  have m₁ : q₁ ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l := by
641	    rcases (mem_footprint.1 hl₁).2.2.2 with h | h
642	    · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
643	    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h
644	  have m₂ : q₂ ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l := by
645	    rcases (mem_footprint.1 hl₂).2.2.2 with h | h
646	    · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
647	    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h
648	  have below : ∀ a b, parentOf s.P a = some st → parentOf s.P b = some st →
649	      b ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) a → False := fun a b ha hb hc => by
650	    rw [chain_cons ha (hpar a st ha)] at hc
651	    have hbst := (hw.parent_lt hb).1
652	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
653	    · exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ hbst
654	    · exact Nat.lt_asymm (chain_lt hc) hbst
655	  rcases chain_total (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q₁ q₂ m₁ m₂ with h | h | h
656	  · exact hne h
657	  · exact below q₂ q₁ hp₂ hp₁ h
658	  · exact below q₁ q₂ hp₁ hp₂ h

777	      ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage) False ∧
778	    ∀ e ∈ r.entries, r.comp < e.1 ∧ ∃ q, sh.places[e.2.1]? = some q ∧
779	      OptP (s.A[e.1]?) (fun y => ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q) False

823	HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
824	theorem PoolOK.transport {s s' : S3} {sh : PoolShape} (h : PoolOK s sh) (hA : Arena.AKeep s s')
825	    (hf : FpKeep s s') : PoolOK s' sh := by
826	  obtain ⟨hm, hfp, ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩, hsl, hin, hd⟩ := h
827	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hym⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hm
828	  obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -⟩ := hA _ y hy
829	  have hst := hf sh.storage l₀ hl₀
830	  have hq : ∀ q ∈ sh.places, ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q := fun q hq' => by
831	    obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := hsl q hq'; exact hf q l₁ hl₁
832	  have hafp : s'.afp sh.internal = s.afp sh.internal := by simp [S3.afp, hy, hy', f']
833	  refine ⟨optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y', hy', m'.trans hym⟩, fun l => ?_, ⟨l₀, (hst l₀).2 hl₀⟩,

1738	/-! ### `freeSlot` after the transfer of the entry's value to a local (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-2)
1739	
1740	From `w4`, the run passes a `Modify` authority over the pool value to a new frame 1, which creates
1741	the local leaf 5 (§72); frame 1 resolves the handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` in `Modify`, writes slot place 1
1742	through the entry authority, transfers its value to the local, unresolves, and frees the slot. -/
1743	
1744	/-- After `derive(1, [3], Modify)` from the root authority of the pool value (§60): authority 4,
1745	the parameter of the next frame (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-2). -/
1746	def x1 : PState := { w4 with kern := deriveEff w4.kern 1 [3] .modify }
1747	
1748	/-- After `enterFrame([4], [(none, 0)])` (§72): frame 1 holds authority 4 and owns the local leaf
1749	5, with its root authority 5 (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-2). -/
1750	def x2 : PState := { x1 with kern := enterEff x1.kern [4] [(none, 0)] }
1751	
1752	/-- After `resolve(0, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, Modify)` in frame 1 (HandlePool v0.5, D.2): the companion 6 over
1753	the storage and the entry authority 7 over slot place 1 (§60). -/
1754	def x3 : PState := { x2 with
1755	  kern := deriveEff (compS x2.kern pl4 .modify) x2.kern.A.length (footprint x2.kern.P 1) .modify
1756	  res := x2.res ++ [⟨pl4.id, pl4.internal, x2.kern.A.length, .modify,
1757	    [(x2.kern.A.length + 1, 0, 0)]⟩] }
1758	
1759	/-- After the kernel `write` of slot place 1 through the entry authority 7 (§67; HandlePool v0.5,
1760	HP5-2). -/
1761	def x4 : PState := { x3 with kern := write3Eff x3.kern [1] }
1762	
1763	/-- After the kernel `transfer(1, 5)` of the entry's value to the local (§63; HandlePool v0.5,
1764	HP5-2): place 1 is `Moved`, place 5 `Init`. -/
1765	def x5 : PState := { x4 with kern := transferEff x4.kern 1 5 }
1766	
1767	/-- After `unresolve(6)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2): `release` of the entry authority 7, then of the
1768	companion 6 (§62). -/
1769	def x6 : PState := { x5 with kern := releaseEff (releaseEff x5.kern 7) 6 }
1770	
1771	/-- After `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1): slot 0 is free, of generation 1; the
1772	kernel state is that of `x6` (§36, §38). -/
1773	def x7 : PState := freeSlotEff x6 0 pl4 0 ⟨1, 0, true⟩
1774	
1775	/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-2 (mandatory proof (1) of arbitration Q3 and its follow-up): from
1776	`PState.init hst`, by accepted steps, `newPool`, `allocSlot`, `resolve` in `Modify`, a kernel
1777	`write` of the entry through the entry authority (§67), the kernel `transfer` of the entry's value
1778	to a local of the same shape (§63), `unresolve`, then `freeSlot` accepted. `internal` (authority 3)
1779	is derived from the root authority of the storage (§60) and stored in the pool value, place 3
1780	(§65). The local is place 5, created by `enterFrame` (§72) and owned by the current frame 1. The
1781	transfer is accepted through the exemption of v0.1 §63.4: the entry authority 7, which grounds the
1782	right over the source, its companion 6, `internal` 3 and its origin 0 cover the source from
1783	outside it. In the arrival state, slot 0 is free with generation 1, slot place 1 is `Moved` and the
1784	local is `Init`. -/
1785	theorem freeSlot_after_transfer :
1786	    NewPoolStep [] 0 3 w2 (.ok w3) ∧ AllocSlotStep 0 4 w3 (.ok w4) ∧
1787	    ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify x2 (.ok x3) ∧ Write3Step 7 [1] x3.kern (.ok x4.kern) ∧
1788	    TransferStep K0 1 5 x4.kern (.ok x5.kern) ∧ UnresolveStep 6 x5 (.ok x6) ∧
1789	    FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ x6 (.ok x7) ∧ PReach K0 hst x7 ∧
1790	    x7.kern.A[3]? = some ⟨.modify, some 0, [1, 2], .place 3, true⟩ ∧
1791	    x7.kern.P[5]? = some ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩ ∧ x7.kern.top = 1 ∧
1792	    x7.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧ x7.kern.I 5 = .init ∧
1793	    x7.pools[0]? = some ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 1, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩ := by
1794	  have r3 : ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify x2 (.ok x3) :=
1795	    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1796	  have w4' : Write3Step 7 [1] x3.kern (.ok x4.kern) := Guarded.ok (by decide)
1797	  have t5 : TransferStep K0 1 5 x4.kern (.ok x5.kern) := Guarded.ok (by decide)
1798	  have hrel : releaseAll x5.kern (unresolveList x5.kern ⟨0, 3, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩) =
1799	      some x6.kern := by
1800	    have e : unresolveList x5.kern ⟨0, 3, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩ = [7, 6] := by decide
1801	    have h7 : ReleasePre x5.kern 7 := by decide
1802	    have h6 : ReleasePre (releaseEff x5.kern 7) 6 := by decide
1803	    rw [e]; simp only [releaseAll, h7, h6, ↓reduceIte]; rfl
1804	  have u6 : UnresolveStep 6 x5 (.ok x6) := .ok (r := ⟨0, 3, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩) rfl hrel
1805	  have f7 : FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ x6 (.ok x7) :=
1806	    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1807	  have h2 : PReach K0 hst x2 := .step (.step w4_reach (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
1808	    (.kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1809	  have h7 : PReach K0 hst x7 :=
1810	    .step (.step (.step (.step (.step h2 (.resolve r3)) (.kernel (.write w4')))
1811	      (.kernel (.transfer t5))) (.unresolve u6)) (.freeSlot f7)
1812	  exact ⟨w3_step, w4_step, r3, w4', t5, u6, f7, h7, by decide, by decide, rfl, by decide,
1813	    by decide, by decide⟩

1815	/-! ### `pool_no_stale_access` after a frame exit (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (2), HP5-1; §42, §73)
1816	
1817	Statics `cst` (§47): place 0 is the pool storage with leaf children 1 and 2 (`Uninit`); place 3 is
1818	the pool value (`Init`); place 4 is the handle destination; place 5 is a leaf of frame 0. Root
1819	authorities 0 to 3 cover places 0, 3, 4 and 5. Frame 1 resolves the handle in `Modify`; the entry
1820	authority is stored into place 5 of frame 0; at the exit of frame 1 the companion dies and the entry
1821	authority is reanchored to `internal` (§73); `freeSlot` is then accepted. -/
1822	
1823	/-- Statics of the run (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
1824	def cst : Statics :=
1825	  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
1826	    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
1827	/-- After `derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)` (§60): `internal` is authority 4 (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
1828	def c1 : PState := { PState.init cst with kern := deriveEff (PState.init cst).kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }
1829	/-- After `store(4, 3)` (§65): `internal` is held by the pool value (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
1830	def c2 : PState := { c1 with kern := storeEff c1.kern 4 3 }
1831	/-- After `newPool(0, 4)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §76). -/
1832	def c3 : PState := newPoolEff c2 0 4
1833	/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §47). -/
1834	def pA : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
1835	/-- After `allocSlot(0, 4)`: the handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is written into place 4 (HandlePool v0.5, D.3;
1836	§67). -/
1837	def c4 : PState := allocSlotEff c3 0 pA 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 4
1838	/-- Pool 0 after `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §47). -/
1839	def pA4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
1840	/-- After `derive(1, [3], Modify)`: authority 5 over the pool value (§60; HandlePool v0.5). -/
1841	def c5 : PState := { c4 with kern := deriveEff c4.kern 1 [3] .modify }
1842	/-- After `derive(3, [5], Modify)`: authority 6 over place 5 (§60; HandlePool v0.5). -/
1843	def c6 : PState := { c5 with kern := deriveEff c5.kern 3 [5] .modify }
1844	/-- After `enterFrame([5, 6], [])`: frame 1 (§72; HandlePool v0.5). -/
1845	def c7 : PState := { c6 with kern := enterEff c6.kern [5, 6] [] }
1846	/-- After `resolve(0, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, Modify)` in frame 1: companion 7, entry authority 8 over slot
1847	place 1 (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60). -/
1848	def c8 : PState := { c7 with
1849	  kern := deriveEff (compS c7.kern pA4 .modify) c7.kern.A.length (footprint c7.kern.P 1) .modify
1850	  res := c7.res ++ [⟨pA4.id, pA4.internal, c7.kern.A.length, .modify,
1851	    [(c7.kern.A.length + 1, 0, 0)]⟩] }
1852	/-- After `store(8, 5)`: the entry authority is held by place 5 of frame 0 (HandlePool v0.5;
1853	§65). -/
1854	def c9 : PState := { c8 with kern := storeEff c8.kern 8 5 }
1855	/-- After `exitFrame`: the companion 7 dies with frame 1; the entry authority 8 survives,
1856	reanchored to `internal` 4 (§73; HandlePool v0.5). -/
1857	def c10 : PState := { c9 with kern := exitEff c9.kern }
1858	/-- After `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` in frame 0 (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; §36, §38). -/
1859	def c11 : PState := freeSlotEff c10 0 pA4 0 ⟨1, 0, true⟩
1860	
1861	/-- Open point (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (2), "aucune autorité d'entrée active ne désigne un slot libre
1862	ou une ancienne génération (`pool_no_stale_access`)", against the HP5-1 content condition read
1863	along the current origin chain, §42; non-normative library contract). Under `DDSound` (§80) and
1864	`StaticsOK` (§47), `c11` is library-reachable; in `c10` the entry authority 8, recorded for slot 0
1865	at generation 0, is active `Modify` over slot place 1 with origin `internal` 4 (reanchored, §73),
1866	and the companion 7 is inactive, so `freeSlot` is accepted; in `c11` slot 0 is free at generation 1
1867	while 8 is still active: `NoStale` and `PoolInv` are false. -/
1868	theorem no_stale_after_exit :
1869	    DDSound K0 ∧ StaticsOK cst ∧ PReach K0 cst c11 ∧
1870	    (⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ : Res) ∈ c10.res ∧
1871	    c10.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [1], .place 5, true⟩ ∧ ¬ c10.kern.Active 7 ∧
1872	    c11.pools = [⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 1, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩] ∧ c11.kern.Active 8 ∧
1873	    ¬ NoStale c11 ∧ ¬ PoolInv c11 := by
1874	  have h3 : PReach K0 cst c3 :=
1875	    .step (.step (.step .init (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
1876	      (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
1877	  have h4 : PReach K0 cst c4 := .step h3 (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := pA) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
1878	  have h7 : PReach K0 cst c7 :=
1879	    .step (.step (.step h4 (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
1880	      (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1881	  have r8 : ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify c7 (.ok c8) :=
1882	    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1883	  have h10 : PReach K0 cst c10 := .step (.step (.step h7 (.resolve r8))
1884	    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.exit (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1885	  have f11 : FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ c10 (.ok c11) :=
1886	    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1887	  have hp : c11.pools = [⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 1, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩] := by decide
1888	  have hn : ¬ NoStale c11 := fun h => by
1889	    obtain ⟨pl, hpl, -, sl, hsl, -, hlv⟩ :=
1890	      h ⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ (by decide) (8, 0, 0) (by decide) (by decide)
1891	    rw [hp, List.mem_singleton] at hpl
1892	    subst hpl
1893	    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hsl
1894	    subst hsl
1895	    cases hlv
1896	  exact ⟨fun _ _ h => h.elim, by decide, .step h10 (.freeSlot f11), by decide, by decide,
1897	    by decide, hp, by decide, hn, fun hi => hn hi.2.1⟩
1898	
1899	/-! ### The write of HP5-3 on a pool value with a `Moved` leaf (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3; §63, §67)
1900	
1901	Statics `vst` (§47): place 0, the pool value, `Init`, with leaves 1 and 2; place 3, the storage,
1902	owned by place 0, with `Uninit` leaves 4 and 5; place 6, an `Uninit` leaf of frame 0. `internal`
1903	is the root authority 1 of the storage, held by its owner, place 0. -/
1904	
1905	/-- Statics of the run (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
1906	def vst : Statics :=
1907	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
1908	    ((none, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false),
1909	    ((none, none, 0), false)]
1910	/-- After `newPool(3, 1)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §76). -/
1911	def m1 : PState := newPoolEff (PState.init vst) 3 1
1912	/-- After the kernel `transfer(1, 6)` of leaf 1 of the pool value to place 6 (HandlePool v0.5;
1913	§63). -/
1914	def m2 : PState := { m1 with kern := transferEff m1.kern 1 6 }
1915	/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §47). -/
1916	def pv : Pool := ⟨0, 3, 1, [⟨4, 0, false⟩, ⟨5, 0, false⟩]⟩
1917	
1918	/-- Limit of HP5-3 (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3; non-normative library contract): `m2` is
1919	library-reachable, pool 0 has `AdminRight` (§36) and its value, place 0, has the `Moved` leaf 1
1920	(§63); the write of the leaves of the pool value (§67) that `freeSlot_meta_write` provides is then
1921	not the identity on the kernel state, while `freeSlot` leaves the kernel state unchanged
1922	(`freeSlot_effect`). -/
1923	theorem meta_write_not_identity :
1924	    StaticsOK vst ∧ PReach K0 vst m2 ∧ m2.pools[0]? = some pv ∧ AdminRight m2.kern pv ∧
1925	    Arena.arenaValue m2.kern pv.entry = some 0 ∧ m2.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧
1926	    write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := by
1927	  have hne : write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := fun e => by
1928	    have h1 := congrArg (fun s : S3 => s.I 1) e
1929	    have : (write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0)).I 1 = .init := by decide
1930	    have h2 : m2.kern.I 1 = .moved := by decide
1931	    rw [this, h2] at h1; cases h1
1932	  exact ⟨by decide, .step (.step .init (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1933	    (.kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok (by decide)))), rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, hne⟩
1934	
1935	end Witness

608	/-- Two parts containing a common leaf are related by the parent chain (§40; HandlePool v0.5). -/
609	theorem chain_total {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ a b, a ∈ i :: chain org i →
610	    b ∈ i :: chain org i → a = b ∨ a ∈ chain org b ∨ b ∈ chain org a
611	  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
612	  | n + 1, i, hi, a, b, ha, hb => by
613	    cases ho : org i with
614	    | none =>
615	      rw [chain_none ho] at ha hb
616	      rw [List.mem_singleton.1 ha, List.mem_singleton.1 hb]; exact .inl rfl
617	    | some o =>
618	      by_cases hlt : o < i
619	      · have hc := chain_cons ho hlt
620	        rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with rfl | hb
621	        · exact .inl rfl
622	        · exact .inr (.inr hb)
623	        · exact .inr (.inl ha)
624	        · rw [hc] at ha hb; exact chain_total n o (by omega) a b ha hb
625	      · have hc : chain org i = [] := by
626	          cases i with
627	          | zero => rfl
628	          | succ k => simp [chain, chainF, ho, hlt]
629	        rw [hc] at ha hb
630	        rw [List.mem_singleton.1 ha, List.mem_singleton.1 hb]; exact .inl rfl

632	/-- Two distinct children of a place have disjoint footprints under `WF3` (§40, §49.2;
633	HandlePool v0.5, D.1: slots are pairwise disjoint). -/
634	theorem kids_disjoint {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {st q₁ q₂ : Nat} (h₁ : q₁ ∈ kids s.P st)
635	    (h₂ : q₂ ∈ kids s.P st) (hne : q₁ ≠ q₂) : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q₁, l ∉ footprint s.P q₂ := by
636	  intro l hl₁ hl₂
637	  obtain ⟨-, hp₁⟩ := mem_kids.1 h₁
638	  obtain ⟨-, hp₂⟩ := mem_kids.1 h₂
639	  have hpar : ∀ i o, parentOf s.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1
640	  have m₁ : q₁ ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l := by
641	    rcases (mem_footprint.1 hl₁).2.2.2 with h | h
642	    · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
643	    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h
644	  have m₂ : q₂ ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l := by
645	    rcases (mem_footprint.1 hl₂).2.2.2 with h | h
646	    · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
647	    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h
648	  have below : ∀ a b, parentOf s.P a = some st → parentOf s.P b = some st →
649	      b ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) a → False := fun a b ha hb hc => by
650	    rw [chain_cons ha (hpar a st ha)] at hc
651	    have hbst := (hw.parent_lt hb).1
652	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
653	    · exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ hbst
654	    · exact Nat.lt_asymm (chain_lt hc) hbst
655	  rcases chain_total (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q₁ q₂ m₁ m₂ with h | h | h

1845	def c7 : PState := { c6 with kern := enterEff c6.kern [5, 6] [] }
1846	/-- After `resolve(0, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, Modify)` in frame 1: companion 7, entry authority 8 over slot
1847	place 1 (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60). -/
1848	def c8 : PState := { c7 with
1849	  kern := deriveEff (compS c7.kern pA4 .modify) c7.kern.A.length (footprint c7.kern.P 1) .modify
1850	  res := c7.res ++ [⟨pA4.id, pA4.internal, c7.kern.A.length, .modify,
1851	    [(c7.kern.A.length + 1, 0, 0)]⟩] }

1853	§65). -/
1854	def c9 : PState := { c8 with kern := storeEff c8.kern 8 5 }
1855	/-- After `exitFrame`: the companion 7 dies with frame 1; the entry authority 8 survives,
1856	reanchored to `internal` 4 (§73; HandlePool v0.5). -/
1857	def c10 : PState := { c9 with kern := exitEff c9.kern }
1858	/-- After `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` in frame 0 (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; §36, §38). -/
1859	def c11 : PState := freeSlotEff c10 0 pA4 0 ⟨1, 0, true⟩
1860	
1861	/-- Open point (HandlePool v0.5, D.4 (2), "aucune autorité d'entrée active ne désigne un slot libre
1862	ou une ancienne génération (`pool_no_stale_access`)", against the HP5-1 content condition read

1867	while 8 is still active: `NoStale` and `PoolInv` are false. -/
1868	theorem no_stale_after_exit :
1869	    DDSound K0 ∧ StaticsOK cst ∧ PReach K0 cst c11 ∧
1870	    (⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ : Res) ∈ c10.res ∧

1874	  have h3 : PReach K0 cst c3 :=
1875	    .step (.step (.step .init (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
1876	      (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
1877	  have h4 : PReach K0 cst c4 := .step h3 (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := pA) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
1878	  have h7 : PReach K0 cst c7 :=
1879	    .step (.step (.step h4 (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
1880	      (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1881	  have r8 : ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify c7 (.ok c8) :=
1882	    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1883	  have h10 : PReach K0 cst c10 := .step (.step (.step h7 (.resolve r8))
1884	    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.exit (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1885	  have f11 : FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ c10 (.ok c11) :=
1886	    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1887	  have hp : c11.pools = [⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 1, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩] := by decide
1888	  have hn : ¬ NoStale c11 := fun h => by
1889	    obtain ⟨pl, hpl, -, sl, hsl, -, hlv⟩ :=
1890	      h ⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ (by decide) (8, 0, 0) (by decide) (by decide)
1891	    rw [hp, List.mem_singleton] at hpl
1892	    subst hpl
1893	    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hsl
1894	    subst hsl
1895	    cases hlv
1896	  exact ⟨fun _ _ h => h.elim, by decide, .step h10 (.freeSlot f11), by decide, by decide,
1897	    by decide, hp, by decide, hn, fun hi => hn hi.2.1⟩
1898	
1899	/-! ### The write of HP5-3 on a pool value with a `Moved` leaf (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3; §63, §67)
1900	
1901	Statics `vst` (§47): place 0, the pool value, `Init`, with leaves 1 and 2; place 3, the storage,
1902	owned by place 0, with `Uninit` leaves 4 and 5; place 6, an `Uninit` leaf of frame 0. `internal`
1903	is the root authority 1 of the storage, held by its owner, place 0. -/
1904	
1905	/-- Statics of the run (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
1906	def vst : Statics :=
1907	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
1908	    ((none, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false),
1909	    ((none, none, 0), false)]
1910	/-- After `newPool(3, 1)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §76). -/
1911	def m1 : PState := newPoolEff (PState.init vst) 3 1
1912	/-- After the kernel `transfer(1, 6)` of leaf 1 of the pool value to place 6 (HandlePool v0.5;
1913	§63). -/
1914	def m2 : PState := { m1 with kern := transferEff m1.kern 1 6 }
1915	/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §47). -/
1916	def pv : Pool := ⟨0, 3, 1, [⟨4, 0, false⟩, ⟨5, 0, false⟩]⟩
1917

1921	not the identity on the kernel state, while `freeSlot` leaves the kernel state unchanged
1922	(`freeSlot_effect`). -/
1923	theorem meta_write_not_identity :
1924	    StaticsOK vst ∧ PReach K0 vst m2 ∧ m2.pools[0]? = some pv ∧ AdminRight m2.kern pv ∧
1925	    Arena.arenaValue m2.kern pv.entry = some 0 ∧ m2.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧
1926	    write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := by
1927	  have hne : write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := fun e => by
1928	    have h1 := congrArg (fun s : S3 => s.I 1) e
1929	    have : (write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0)).I 1 = .init := by decide
1930	    have h2 : m2.kern.I 1 = .moved := by decide
1931	    rw [this, h2] at h1; cases h1
1932	  exact ⟨by decide, .step (.step .init (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
1933	    (.kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok (by decide)))), rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, hne⟩
1934	
1935	end Witness

1937	end Ern.Lib.HandlePool

structure PoolWF (L : PState) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: identities are below the next fresh identity. -/
  ids : ∀ sh ∈ L.pools.map Pool.shape, sh.id < L.nId
  /-- HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: identities are distinct. -/
  nodup : ((L.pools.map Pool.shape).map (·.id)).Nodup
  /-- HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: every pool is well formed. -/
  pools : ∀ sh ∈ L.pools.map Pool.shape, PoolOK L.kern sh
  /-- HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: every ghost resolution is well formed. -/
  res : ∀ r ∈ L.res, ResOK L.kern (L.pools.map Pool.shape) r

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` as a state predicate (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 2; non-normative
library contract): no active entry authority designates a free slot or a former generation (§89). -/
def NoStale (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ L.res, ∀ e ∈ r.entries, L.kern.Active e.1 → ∃ pl ∈ L.pools, pl.id = r.pool ∧
    ∃ sl, pl.slots[e.2.1]? = some sl ∧ sl.gen = e.2.2 ∧ sl.live = true

/-- Exclusivity of companions, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative
library contract): two distinct active companions of a pool are both `Observe` (§43, §50). The
contract's sentence also covers the companions of other pools (`ModifyExclusive`). -/
def CompExcl (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → r₁.comp ≠ r₂.comp →
    L.kern.Active r₁.comp → L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .observe ∧ r₂.mode = .observe

/-- Footprints of every place with a leaf are kept (§40; support for HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
def FpKeep (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q l₀, l₀ ∈ footprint s.P q → ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Same places keep footprints (§40; support for HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
theorem fpKeep_of_P {s s' : S3} (h : s'.P = s.P) : FpKeep s s' := fun _ _ _ _ => by rw [h]

/-- Kernel steps keep footprints (§40; §60–§75 effects; support for HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
theorem fpKeep_kstep {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : FpKeep s s' :=
  fun _ _ h₀ l => Arena.kstep_fp h (Arena.footprint_lt h₀) l

/-- `FpKeep` composes (§40; support for HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
theorem FpKeep.trans {s s₁ s₂ : S3} (h₁ : FpKeep s s₁) (h₂ : FpKeep s₁ s₂) : FpKeep s s₂ :=
  fun q l₀ h₀ l => (h₂ q l₀ ((h₁ q l₀ h₀ l₀).2 h₀) l).trans (h₁ q l₀ h₀ l)

/-- A sequence of kernel steps keeps the authorities and the footprints (§42, §58; §60–§75;
HandlePool v0.4 annex). -/
theorem KSeq.keep {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KSeq k s s') : Arena.AKeep s s' ∧ FpKeep s s' := by
----
    ∀ (a b : Nat) (sa sb : Slot), pl.slots[a]? = some sa → pl.slots[b]? = some sb → a ≠ b →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P sa.place, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P sb.place

/-- `PoolInv`, item 3, the transition guarantee, as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex,
D.4: "`freeSlot` n'aboutit jamais si une descendante active d'une compagne couvre le slot
concerné"; non-normative library contract): `freeSlot` never succeeds while an active strict
descendant of a companion covers the slot concerned (§43, §69). The contract does not restrict the
companion to the pool of the slot. This guarantee is false on a library-reachable state
(`Witness.pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_false`): D.3 exempts "`internal` et ses ancêtres", which
may include a companion of another pool. -/
def FreeGuarantee (k : K) (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L' : PState), FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok L') →
    ∀ (pl : Pool) (sl : Slot), L.pools[j]? = some pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      ∀ r ∈ L.res, ∀ x, L.kern.Active x → r.comp ∈ L.kern.ancs x →
        ∀ l ∈ L.kern.afp x, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P sl.place

/-- Same-pool restriction of the transition guarantee (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 3;
non-normative library contract). This is not the contract's statement (`FreeGuarantee`): only the
companions of the slot's pool are quantified (`r.pool = pl.id`). On that point it is weaker; it also
covers the companion itself, and on that point it is stronger (§43, §69). -/
def FreeGuaranteeSamePool (k : K) (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L' : PState), FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok L') →
    ∀ (pl : Pool) (sl : Slot), L.pools[j]? = some pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      ∀ r ∈ L.res, r.pool = pl.id → ∀ x, L.kern.Active x → (x = r.comp ∨ r.comp ∈ L.kern.ancs x) →
        ∀ l ∈ L.kern.afp x, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P sl.place

/-- `PoolInv` as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, as corrected; non-normative
library contract): entry disjointness, `pool_no_stale_access`, and the transition guarantee of
`freeSlot` (§55, §57). It is false on a library-reachable state
(`Witness.pool_inv_preserved_false`). -/
def PoolInv (k : K) (L : PState) : Prop := EntriesDisjoint L ∧ NoStale L ∧ FreeGuarantee k L

/-- Same-pool restriction of `PoolInv` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4; non-normative library
contract): items 1 and 2 as the contract states them, item 3 restricted to the companions of the
slot's pool (`FreeGuaranteeSamePool`). This is not the contract's statement (`PoolInv`) (§55,
§57). -/
def PoolInvSamePool (k : K) (L : PState) : Prop :=
  EntriesDisjoint L ∧ NoStale L ∧ FreeGuaranteeSamePool k L

/-- `EntriesDisjoint` follows from the ghost well-formedness (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 1)
(§40). -/
theorem entriesDisjoint_of {L : PState} (hwf : PoolWF L) : EntriesDisjoint L := by
  intro pl hpl
  have hok := hwf.pools _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hpl)
  exact ⟨fun sl hsl l hl => hok.slotIn sl.place (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := (·.place)) hsl) l hl,
    fun a b sa sb ha hb hab => hok.disjoint a b sa.place sb.place
      (by simp [Pool.shape, ha]) (by simp [Pool.shape, hb]) hab⟩

/-- The same-pool transition guarantee follows from the ghost well-formedness
(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 3, restricted to the slot's pool): an active descendant of a
companion of the pool is younger than `internal`, so it is neither `internal` nor one of its
ancestors, and `ContentEndPre` forbids it to cover the entry (§43, §69). -/
theorem freeGuaranteeSamePool_of {k : K} {L : PState} (hwf : PoolWF L) :
    FreeGuaranteeSamePool k L := by
  intro j h L' hst pl sl hpj hsl r hr hrp x hx hxr l hl hlq
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl' sl' hpj' _ _ hsl' hpre =>
    rw [hpj] at hpj'; cases hpj'
    rw [hsl] at hsl'; cases hsl'
    obtain ⟨hint, hlt, -, -⟩ := res_internal hwf hr (List.mem_of_getElem? hpj) hrp
    obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hx
    have hex := hpre.entry x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ ⟨l, hl, hlq⟩
    have hcx : r.comp ≤ x := by
      rcases hxr with rfl | hc
      · exact Nat.le_refl _
      · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt hc)
    unfold Exempt at hex
    rcases hex with rfl | h'
    · omega
    · have := chain_lt h'; omega

/-- `pool_inv_preserved`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4): `PoolInvSamePool`
holds on every state of a library run whose steps start from states satisfying `KInv` (§57); with
`PReach.toI`, on every library-reachable state under the guarantee of §57. This is not the
contract's statement: `PoolInv` is false on such a state (`Witness.pool_inv_preserved_false`). -/
theorem pool_inv_preserved_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) : PoolInvSamePool k L :=
  have ⟨_, hwf, hns, _⟩ := pReachI_inv h
  ⟨entriesDisjoint_of hwf, hns, freeGuaranteeSamePool_of hwf⟩

/-- `pool_entries_disjoint` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 1; §40). -/
theorem pool_entries_disjoint {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    EntriesDisjoint L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).1

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 2): on every state of a library run
(`PReachI`), an active entry authority designates a live slot at its current generation (§89). -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    NoStale L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.1

/-- `pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 3):
on every state of a library run (`PReachI`), `freeSlot` never succeeds while the companion of a
resolution of the pool, or an active descendant of it, covers the slot (§43, §69). This is not the
contract's statement: `FreeGuarantee` is false on such a state
(`Witness.pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_false`). -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) : FreeGuaranteeSamePool k L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.2

/-- Exclusivity of a `Modify` companion, as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
"Une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool";
non-normative library contract): an active `Modify` companion of a pool is the only active
companion that covers a leaf of that pool's storage (§43, §50). The contract does not restrict the
other companions to the same pool. This property is false on a library-reachable state
(`Witness.pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_false`). -/
def ModifyExclusive (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, ∀ pl ∈ L.pools, r₁.pool = pl.id → L.kern.Active r₁.comp →
    L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify →
    (∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp r₂.comp, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P pl.storage) → r₁.comp = r₂.comp

# Annexe D — Instance `HandlePool` (non normative, contrat de bibliothèque)

Cette annexe décrit une **instance de bibliothèque** de la discipline MM-03, et non une nouvelle opération primitive du langage. Les noms sont sémantiques. Le contrat doit être reconstruit et vérifié ; les résultats du jalon 3 concernent le modèle exploratoire et ses conditions, **pas** automatiquement les règles corrigées ci-dessous.

## D.1 — Identité, état et stockage

Un handle est une donnée `(poolId, slot, gen)` **sans autorité d'accès intrinsèque**. L'identité logique `poolId` est fraîche et n'est pas réutilisée pendant l'exécution pertinente : détruire puis recréer un pool à la même adresse ne réactive pas un ancien handle. Chaque pool vivant conserve une entrée abstraite `{storage, internal, slots}`, où chaque slot possède `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`. Les slots sont des sous-emplacements deux à deux disjoints, inclus dans `storage` ; leur métadonnée abstraite est représentée en octets par l'implémentation de bibliothèque.

`storage` peut être local, statique, alloué ou être un bloc issu d'une arène. **`newPool(storage, internal)` exige que toutes les feuilles du stockage d'entrée soient `Uninit`** et doit vérifier la garde unifiée de MM-03.3 §2.7 bis sur les deux registres des abstractions vivantes. Il reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena` sans fabriquer ni droits ni initialisation des valeurs de slots. Les entrées libres sont `Uninit` ; leur génération initiale est zéro. Une autorité ne peut être `internal` de deux abstractions vivantes, et une arène ne peut réutiliser l'`internal` d'un pool vivant.

## D.2 — Emprunt composé et résolution

Une résolution réussie dérive **de `internal` une autorité compagne** couvrant toutes les feuilles du stockage du pool, de mode `Observe` ou `Modify`, puis dérive **de cette compagne** une autorité de même mode par entrée résolue. L'autorité d'entrée est une descendante de la compagne, et non une autre dérivation indépendante de `internal`. Les deux sont soumises aux règles ordinaires de modes effectifs, d'exercice, de détention, d'ancrage et de transfert ; aucune permission nouvelle n'est créée.

`resolve(h, Observe | Modify)` vérifie l'identité de pool, la génération et la vivacité du slot **avant toute création d'autorité** : handle d'un autre pool, périmé, slot absent ou libre ⇒ `fail`, sans changement d'état. Une résolution valide exige l'exercice légal de `internal` au mode requis. Une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool ; des compagnes `Observe` peuvent coexister. Il est impossible de libérer une compagne tant que ses descendantes d'entrée sont actives (O3.2). La propriété d'exclusivité concerne toutes les suites d'opérations admises du noyau, pas seulement deux appels successifs de `resolve`.

`resolveMany(handles, Modify)` crée **une** compagne `Modify` et une autorité `Modify` par entrée. La distinction des slots est vérifiée dynamiquement pour ce lot ; toute identité invalide, génération périmée, entrée libre ou répétition de slot donne `fail` **atomique**, sans création partielle de droits. `resolveMany(handles, Observe)` utilise des dérivations `Observe` de la compagne `Observe`, **sans `split` ni contrôle de distinction** : la répétition du même handle valide est permise. Les `reject` de discipline d'accès restent distincts des `fail` de validation des handles.

`unresolve` libère d'abord toutes les dérivées d'entrée encore actives, puis la compagne. Les règles de `release`, y compris celles qui empêchent la libération en présence de descendants ou d'ancres valides, restent applicables ; le contrat ne supprime pas silencieusement des autorités transférées.

## D.3 — Allocation et fin d'usage de slot

`allocSlot(pool, dst)` exige un pool vivant, l'autorisation d'administration de ses métadonnées, une destination utilisable et libre d'autorité active, non `Init`, apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle. `fail` si aucun slot libre ; `ok` choisit un slot libre, le rend vivant, conserve sa génération et écrit son handle dans la seule feuille `dst`, selon les obligations de représentation (Spec 4) et d'ABI (Spec 11). **Le contenu du slot demeure `Uninit`** jusqu'à son écriture ; l'écriture du handle dans `dst` n'initialise pas le slot.

`freeSlot(h)` exige un pool **vivant** et `MetaRight`, c'est-à-dire le droit légal d'administration de la valeur pool par `Modify` exerçable ou par mutation `writeShared` admissible de ses métadonnées `SharedMutable`. `fail` si l'identité ou la génération ne correspond pas ; un slot déjà libre n'est pas rendu libérable par cette seule égalité. Pour réussir, la fin logique du contenu doit être admissible : **aucune dépendance utilisable** ne serait invalidée, **aucune feuille n'est épinglée**, et **aucune autorité active ne couvre l'entrée hors `internal` et ses ancêtres**. En particulier, aucune descendante active d'une compagne ne doit subsister sur cette entrée. Le contrôle n'interprète pas `internal` comme un emprunt externe empêchant systématiquement le nettoyage de ses propres slots.

L'effet `ok` applique au **contenu** les effets de fin d'usage d'`endUse`, remet les feuilles de l'entrée à `Uninit`, marque l'entrée libre et incrémente sa génération ; **il ne désalloue pas implicitement l'allocation MM-02 du stockage**. Il ne s'agit pas de supposer une invocation de O12 autorisée par simple `MetaRight` : la correspondance des effets et la préservation des invariants sous ce droit constituent une **obligation explicite de reconstruction**, notamment dans les cas `writeShared`.

## D.4 — Invariant corrigé et limites

`PoolInv` exige : (1) les entrées sont deux à deux disjointes et incluses dans le stockage ; (2) aucune autorité d'entrée active ne désigne un slot libre ou une ancienne génération (`pool_no_stale_access`) ; (3) **garantie de transition** : `freeSlot` n'aboutit jamais si une descendante active d'une compagne couvre le slot concerné. La dernière clause concerne le succès des transitions, non une interdiction globale de toutes les dérivations du noyau sur des slots libres. Les dérivations ordinaires issues d'une autorité d'entrée restent permises par le noyau.

Les générations sont des entiers naturels dans le modèle abstrait. Leur débordement ou leur recyclage dans une représentation finie doivent être empêchés par l'implémentation (par exemple retrait définitif d'un slot) ; l'ABI est spécifiée en Spec 11. L'encapsulation qui empêche un client d'accéder directement à une compagne administrative appartient à la Spec 9. Les handles persistants peuvent représenter des liens cycliques ; les résolutions qui en découlent restent temporaires et soumises à MM-03.

**Statut des preuves :** le jalon 3 rapporte `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive`, `pool_no_stale_access`, `pool_resolveMany_atomic`, `pool_resolveMany_distinct`, `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` et `pool_entries_disjoint` sur son brouillon, sous les hypothèses détaillées dans `J3_v0.1.md`. Il rapporte également un contre-exemple à l'ancienne formulation de `pool_inv_preserved`. **Il ne constitue pas encore la preuve** de la nouvelle règle `freeSlot` sous `MetaRight` ni de la totalité du contrat corrigé : ces obligations sont consignées en annexe F.

# Annexe E — Registre inter-spécifications (non normatif pour la Spec 1)

| Destination | Obligations ouvertes ou précisées |
|---|---|
| **Spec 2 — Concurrence** | Partie concurrente de `stat` ; `writeShared` et synchronisation ; transférabilité, partageabilité, suspension concurrente ; cas H39, H41. |
| **Spec 3 — Contrôle de flux et appels** | Protection forte de paramètres (`Reach`, `lineage`, `derivedIn`, G1', A3 strict) ; ré-emprunt d'un paramètre `Modify` par un paramètre dérivé `Observe` (H01, admis dans le noyau séquentiel, sans promettre la protection forte) ; **passage par valeur (`sink`) vers l'appelé** : prévoir la primitive MM-03 correspondante, transfert d'un emplacement de l'appelant vers un local de l'appelé au moment de l'entrée, sans affaiblir arbitrairement O4 ; retour et `defer` (H16, H27b, H38, H40, H42). |
| **Spec 4 — Types** | Validité de représentation (`dec`), `SameSizeAlong`, information de forme pour des régions non contiguës, feuille de destination d'une référence typée, correspondance `kind` et type ; **mémoire rendue par une abstraction de réutilisation (bloc d'arène réémis, entrée de pool) exposée comme typée non initialisée jusqu'à écriture explicite**, sans réinterprétation implicite d'anciens octets. La décision ne change pas rétroactivement les effets d'initialisation de `reset` sur l'état abstrait MM-03. |
| **Spec 9 — Encapsulation** | Empêcher l'usage extérieur des autorités internes/compagnes administratives des bibliothèques sûres. |
